records.text: The notice says Chief Long’s text led TPUSA to reasonably conclude UVU had a plan for the identified rooftop risk and similar rooftop risks without TPUSA involvement, and alleges his message did not invite or allow TPUSA to secure unsecured rooftops.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #15 (Ep aLJhpxrakCU)

appearances.snippet: They say this led TPUSA to reasonably conclude that UVU had a plan to address the identified risk and other similar risks, most obviously the risk from other rooftops, without TPUSA involvement. ... Chief Long (Jeffrey Long)'s text message did not invite or even allow Turning Point USA to take any steps to secure the risk of unsecured rooftops.

records.text: The notice alleges UVU parties’ omissions, actions and misconduct led to Charlie Kirk’s death by exposing him to a rooftop shooter, supporting a state-created danger claim under the Constitution’s due process clause and a wrongful death claim under Utah law.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #15 (Ep aLJhpxrakCU)

appearances.snippet: It says, the UVU party's omissions, actions, and misconduct led to Mr. Kirk (Charlie Kirk)'s death. All of these failures placed Mr. ... Kirk (Charlie Kirk) in danger. He was legally entitled to believe that when the UVU parties approved the tour event to be held on campus on September 10th, that the UVU parties would only hold the event in a venue. ... and with associated security measures that made the event safe for him to attend and participate in. Instead, Mr. ... Kirk (Charlie Kirk) was exposed to the danger of a rooftop shooter that took his life. In light of the risks known to the UVU parties, the UVU parties' failures shock the conscience, giving rise both to a state-created danger claim. ... Under the United States Constitution's due process clause and a traditional wrongful death claim under Utah law. Thank you for receiving the above notice of claim.
